Regime A, tight intra-DC (RDMA-like): testbed p99/median about 1.1 gives L/U = 0.9; sd/U = 0.1 fast path; W/U = 10 follows etcd's >= 10x election rule.
Regime B, intra-DC TCP: same-subnet cloud VMs give L/U about 0.3; uncongested socket residence is negligible (sd = 0); W/U = 3.
Regime C, inter-AZ: L/U about 0.1; sd/U = 0.25 covers p99 socket residence under load; W/U = 5 mid headroom.
Regime F, adversarial: congested tail widens the transit window (L = 0); backpressure storage sd/U = 0.5; minimum headroom W/U = 2.
